--- a/apps/worker/exceptions.py
+++ b/apps/worker/exceptions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+"""Worker exceptions.
+
+The retryable flag is metadata for consumers of this module.
+This module does not define how consumers combine it with other
+signals when deciding whether to retry.
+"""
+
+class ProcessingError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, retryable=False):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.retryable = retryable

note: Globally clean: the claim is strictly self-scoped — it asserts nothing about code outside the diff.
